title: ToxLens: A Reproducible Graph-Learning Framework for Leakage-Aware, Uncertainty-Calibrated Molecular Toxicity Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.30472v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Molecular toxicity prediction is increasingly used to prioritise compounds before experimental testing, but conventional benchmark performance can overstate practical utility when structurally related molecules occur across training and test folds. We introduce ToxLens, a reproducible multi-task graph-learning framework for 11 toxicity endpoints spanning Ames mutagenicity, acute oral toxicity, hERG inhibition, and Tox21 nuclear-receptor and stress-response assays. The workflow combines conservative chemical curation, sphere-exclusion filtering, a leakage-aware UMAP-HDBSCAN split, parallel graph and global-feature encoders joined by late concatenation, temperature-scaled Monte Carlo dropout with conformal-style prediction sets, applicability-domain analysis, and SHAP-guided toxicophore discovery with occlusion controls. On the leakage-controlled test fold, a five-seed soft-voting ensemble achieved a Matthews correlation coefficient score

translated_title: ToxLens：一个面向泄漏感知、不确定性校准分子毒性预测的可复现图学习框架
translated_abstract: 分子毒性预测正日益被用于在实验测试之前对化合物进行优先级排序，但当结构相关的分子同时出现在训练集和测试集中时，传统的基准测试性能可能会夸大其实际应用价值。我们提出了ToxLens，一个可复现的多任务图学习框架，涵盖11个毒性终点，包括Ames致突变性、急性口服毒性、hERG抑制以及Tox21核受体和应激反应检测。该工作流程结合了保守的化学数据整理、球排除过滤、泄漏感知的UMAP-HDBSCAN数据集划分、通过后期拼接连接的并行图编码器与全局特征编码器、带温度缩放的蒙特卡洛dropout与共形风格预测集、应用域分析，以及结合遮挡控制的SHAP引导毒性药效团发现。在泄漏控制的测试集上，五种子软投票集成模型取得了马修斯相关系数（MCC）分数……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了可复现的图学习框架ToxLens，通过泄漏感知的数据划分与不确定性校准技术，为11个分子毒性终点提供更可靠的毒性预测，并支持毒性药效团发现。
en_tdlr: ToxLens is a reproducible multi-task graph-learning framework that tackles data leakage and uncertainty calibration to deliver more reliable predictions across 11 molecular toxicity endpoints, along with SHAP-guided toxicophore discovery.
